# Review priorities

Focus on consequential bugs, data exposure, misleading authorization claims, inaccessible core content and broken development workflows. Suggest concrete fixes and regression tests where useful. Do not comment on cosmetics, naming preferences or speculative future features.

This repository is private and unpublished. Flag any deployment, public exposure, external tracking or unexpected network dependency. The approval workflow is illustrative and must not imply real purchases, working authentication, production readiness or proof of humanity.

Copilot supplements independent adversarial review and maintainer approval. Do not claim tests were run unless they were. These instructions do not enable automatic review or authorize merging or deployment.
